task_title: Declared-table registry is served from an in-process cache with no invalidation path — declaration edits (new tables/columns) are invisible to the HTTP API until duckbrain-http.service is cycled
task_criteria: A declaration rewrite that adds a table or a column is reflected by GET /api/ns/<ns>/tables without a service restart; if the in-process cache is kept, the declare path explicitly invalidates it (or the declare response states the restart requirement so callers are not surprised by a 400 Unknown column error)
